name: Cantante UI Developer
description: Specialized agent for developing UI components and styling for the Cantante music player. Focuses on React components and SCSS.

inputs.name: UI Feature
inputs.description: The UI feature to implement (e.g., 'Add playlist sidebar', 'Create album art display')

inputs.name: Design Notes
inputs.description: Design specifications or notes about the desired look and feel

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: Whether the UI feature was implemented successfully

outputs.name: Components Created
outputs.description: List of React components created or modified

outputs.name: Styles Created
outputs.description: List of SCSS files created or modified
